concerns: Input EAN 888837168626 has an invalid check digit; the agent assumed a typo and corrected it to 888837168625. This is supported by the notes field but is an inference.

Discogs barcode search (tool call 5) returned 27 hits, truncated in the output; the tracklists of the other barcode-matching pressings (e.g. release 4715855 South Korea, 12858653) were not verified, although the result claims identical tracks for all of them.
Track 13 'Contact' duration conflict: MB 384 s (CD-TOC 383626 ms) vs Discogs 381 s. The explanation that Discogs reflects the digital/streaming version is speculation, not supported by the evidence.

Discogs durations for tracks 3-11 are consistently 1 s lower than MB (truncation vs rounding); the result's statement that Discogs differs by ≤1 s for 12 tracks is accurate but the rounding explanation is not verified.
The edition label 'Standard-Edition 2013 (EU-Pressung)' is only partly supported: Discogs says 'Europe' and 'Made in EU', while MB says DE; the edition name itself is not documented in the evidence.
The back-cover image comes from the CAA entry linked to the MusicBrainz release, so it is not fully independent of MusicBrainz.
The total_duration_s 4477 s is the sum of MB CD-TOC durations; the Discogs sum (4468 s) is noted in the evidence but not in the result.
